description: Fork a design at a revision into a **branch** to explore an alternative, or to change it without trampling somebody editing it live. A branch is a design with its own id: edit it with ui_builder_apply, look at it with ui_builder_view or ui_builder_get_design, compare it with ui_builder_diff_designs, then bring it back with ui_builder_merge_branch or drop it with ui_builder_archive_branch. Branch N times from the same revision to try N alternatives: merging one archives the others. Branches of a branch are refused; so are asset uploads, restores and document replacements on a branch. Needs write access to the design.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

branchId.description: The branch's design id. Defaults to one minted from the parent's; naming one makes a retry idempotent.

name.description: What this alternative is, e.g. `compact header`.

revision.description: A retained revision to fork at. Omit for the current one.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_branch_design
